name: measuring-notice
js: state.background.kind = "lake"; tab = TABS.findIndex(t => /Advanced/.test(t[0])); showTab(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('#panel button')].find(b => /this computer's speed/.test(b.textContent)).click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 6000))

name: solids-forest
js: state.background.kind = "forest"; changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', g = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g'); g.setAttribute('pointer-events', 'none'); for (const o of solidsHere()) { const r = document.createElementNS(NS, 'rect'); r.setAttribute('x', o.x0); r.setAttribute('y', o.back); r.setAttribute('width', Math.max(1, o.x1 - o.x0)); r.setAttribute('height', Math.max(2, o.front - o.back)); r.setAttribute('fill', o.standing ? 'rgba(255,0,0,0.45)' : 'rgba(255,160,0,0.45)'); r.setAttribute('stroke', o.standing ? 'red' : 'orange'); r.setAttribute('stroke-width', 2); g.appendChild(r); } if (Number.isFinite(sceneFrame.back)) { const l = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line'); l.setAttribute('x1', sceneFrame.left); l.setAttribute('x2', sceneFrame.right); l.setAttribute('y1', sceneFrame.back); l.setAttribute('y2', sceneFrame.back); l.setAttribute('stroke', 'blue'); l.setAttribute('stroke-width', 3); l.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '12 6'); g.appendChild(l); } bgShown.node.appendChild(g)
